node: Consumer-credit enablement, private-label card servicing, installment underwriting, fraud, and merchant financing rails
summary: This pass expands the universe around the consumer-credit enablement node with a two-lane structure: one reference leader for private-label / co-brand retail credit context, and three underfollowed or shadow-lane names tied to private-label credit, ecommerce fraud conversion, and embedded AI underwriting. The main chokepoint is not simply consumer-credit demand; it is the ability to approve incremental retail transactions while controlling losses, fraud, compliance, funding cost, and merchant/partner concentration. In a weak consumer-credit cycle, lender-like names can become risk concentrators, so later layers should separate fee/software/data exposure from balance-sheet credit exposure.
